claim: Stale, substituted-but-valid, mismatched, tampered, or missing repository identity cannot silently receive MASTER_DRIFT = PASS. Includes the review BLOCKER case: closure verified SHA replaced by a different syntactically valid 40-hex git SHA (the live HEAD) while IMPORT_PROVENANCE still pins 9eb5da3d.
output: NEGATIVE SUBSTITUTED_VALID_SHA_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - a substituted but syntactically valid verified SHA (current HEAD) must FAIL
NEGATIVE STALE_HEAD_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - an unrelated HEAD must never receive PASS
NEGATIVE NORMATIVE_DRIFT_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - post-verification commits touching normative paths must never receive PASS
NEGATIVE NON_PASS_GRANT_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - a closure that does not grant PASS must never receive PASS
NEGATIVE TAMPERED_VERIFIED_SHA_INVALID_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - a malformed verified SHA must never receive PASS
NEGATIVE TAMPERED_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED_SHA_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - editing the provenance-side verified master must contradict the closure and FAIL
NEGATIVE TAMPERED_BASELINE_SHA_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - rewriting the REV3 baseline SHA breaks recorded ancestry and must FAIL
NEGATIVE WRONG_SCHEMA_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - an unrecognized closure schema must never receive PASS
NEGATIVE UNBOUND_SIBLING_EDIT_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - digest-bound siblings must be rejected on any edit without reclosure
NEGATIVE UNRECORDED_IMPORT_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - every promoted evidence file must stay digest-recorded
NEGATIVE MISSING_EVIDENCE_REJECTED: rejected (FAIL) - absent evidence must be rejected, never PASS
NEGATIVE_SELF_TEST = PASS (no stale or mismatched identity can receive PASS)
